notes.title: rTexPacker 5.0
notes.content:
Official release for rTexPacker v5.0. Features on this release:
ADDED: New UI visual style: GenesisADDED: Support sprite(s) tag nameADDED: Support sprite(s) manual positioningADDED: Support sprite(s) slicing by alphaADDED: Support per-sprite trimmingADDED: Support sprite(s) collider definitionADDED: Sprite list view with namesADDED: Exporting new sprite properties: tag, collider...ADDED: CLI: Sprite slicing supportADDED: CLI: Show unpacked sprites infoREDESIGNED: Sprite view window, added sprite toolsREDESIGNED: RTP file-format, load/save atlas configREVIEWED: Initialization config optionsREVIEWED: Sprite grid view panelREVIEWED: Status bar info, show more dataREVIEWED: Only redraw render texture when required (disabled)REMOVED: Sprite shaders (needs redesign)UPDATED: Using raylib 5.6-dev and raygui 4.5-dev
Enjoy rTexPacker!

notes.title: rTexPacker v4.0
notes.content:
Official release for rTexPacker v4.0. Features on this release:

 - ADDED: New welcome/about window
 - ADDED: Sprite multi-selection on atlas and sprite-list
 - ADDED: Sprite origin positions selector from list
 - ADDED: Configuration file support: config.ini
 - ADDED: Sprite shader support (experimental)
 - ADDED: Sprite index movement left-right inside list
 - ADDED: Support forced font monospace width option
 - ADDED: Support [code single].rtp image data compressed by default
 - ADDED: New UI style available: [code single]amber
 - ADDED: Clear sprite list confirmation message box
 - ADDED: New atlas confirmation message box
 - ADDED: Sprite shader toggle shortcut (J)
 - ADDED: CLI: Parameter to force font monospace width
 - REMOVED: Texture scale filter toggle
 - REMOVED: Clear screen button and logic
 - REVIEWED: Origin edit shortcut key (G)
 - REVIEWED: Sprites view window to fill all height
 - REVIEWED: Help window to add latest shortcuts
 - REVIEWED: Help window to recenter properly
 - REVIEWED: Mouse wheel zoom to mouse position
 - REVIEWED: CLI: Load directory files recursively
 - UPDATED: UI styles to support Latin-1 Ext
 - UPDATED: Using raygui 4.5-dev and raylib 5.5-dev

Enjoy rTexPacker!
